audit.why: Spinning Axe is 12/11/10/9/8s at rank; naming that number lets a reader actually count the punish window instead of vibing it. The Do/Don't titles promise something the bodies don't deliver.
audit.corrected: See edits: breakdown.cooldowns now states the 12/11/10/9/8s Spinning Axe cooldown and the E Stand Aside 16-12s window; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten to match their own titles.

edits.before: - Draven Spinning Axe: matchup-defining — Two spinning axes is lane-bully damage — stand on his pickup spots and his power halves. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Featherstorm has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Spinning Axe is 12/11/10/9/8s — miss the catch once and his damage halves for that stretch; stand on the pickup spot and punish it. - His Stand Aside knock-aside is 16/15/14/13/12s; wait it out before you commit E. - Your R Featherstorm has one job: the moment it all goes wrong, or right.
